title: Pasar Tani Pagi Ahad
mood: a town becoming one room once a week
subject: a Sunday farmers market where the cake man still calls you adik at thirty
caption: Malay ska. Electric guitar playing the upstroke skank on every offbeat, a three-piece horn section playing bright unison lines and stabs, a walking electric bass running up and down, an organ bubble pattern underneath, a drum kit with a driving hi-hat and rimshots. Bright and bouncy with the horns forward and a slightly raw live sound. Male voice, cheerful and quick, conversational, with gang shouts on the chorus. 152 BPM, C major. A town becoming one room once a week. No synth, no programmed drums, no autotune, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - skank guitar and horn section]

[Verse 1]
Pagi Ahad, pasar tani, tujuh pagi dah sesak
Mak bawa troli, aku bawa beg, ayah bawa dompet je
Makcik sayur tawar-menawar dengan mak lima minit
Untuk lima puluh sen, dua-dua menang, dua-dua puas

[Chorus]
Pasar tani pagi Ahad
Bukan sebab murah, sebab semua orang kenal
Pakcik ikan tahu mak nak ikan kembung, tak payah cakap
Seminggu sekali, kampung ni jadi satu bilik

[Verse 2]
Abang kuih bagi aku satu lebih, setiap minggu
Aku tak tahu nama dia, dia panggil aku "adik"
Aku dah tiga puluh, dia masih panggil "adik"
Aku tak betulkan, aku suka jadi adik sekejap

[Chorus]
Pasar tani pagi Ahad
Bukan sebab murah, sebab semua orang kenal
Pakcik ikan tahu mak nak ikan kembung, tak payah cakap
Seminggu sekali, kampung ni jadi satu rumah

[Outro - horns, cut]
Troli penuh
Minggu depan lagi
